work_history.title: Founder
work_history.description:
Multi-model measurement engine (Python). One provider gateway in front of 12 models. Each audit sends real buyer questions to five web-search-enabled assistants and repeats every question several times per model, so results are reported as stability bands, not one lucky reply.
Integrity layer: 20 deterministic checks, zero model calls. Nothing the LLM workers claim is taken on faith: quotes must be verbatim, cited URLs must exist in the answer, competitors must be grounded in the text, metrics are recounted, and the run must prove that web search actually happened, that each answer came from…

evidence.skills: Multi-model orchestration, LLM evaluation and anti-fabrication checks, web-search-grounded generation, structured extraction, Claude Code, Python, TypeScript, Node.js, Next.JS, SQL, web scraping, React Native, Vercel, Cloudflare DNS, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Git, Github, B2B sales and outreach, market and competitive research, Pricing, Client Communication
